violations.description: pull_request_target checkout of untrusted PR head ref
violations.evidence: pull_request_target workflow checks out ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
violations.recommendation: Avoid using pull_request_target with actions/checkout checking out untrusted head references, or use safe workflows triggered by pull_request without write permissions/checkout of untrusted code.

violations.description: Untrusted pull request inputs interpolated directly into run script
violations.evidence: echo "Thanks for the PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" and echo "From: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" in run step
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables rather than direct string interpolation into bash scripts.

violations.description: Hardcoded API key in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Move sensitive API keys and secrets to GitHub Repository Secrets and reference them using secrets.API_KEY.

violations.description: Missing permissions block in GitHub Actions workflows
violations.evidence: Workflows across .github/workflows/ (auto-label.yml, ci.yml, greet-pr.yml, manual-deploy.yml, setup.yml) omit the permissions: block, leaving default GITHUB_TOKEN privileges.
violations.recommendation: Define explicit least-privilege permissions: blocks for all workflows.
